title: When a stablecoin is not stable (Terra Luna meme)
description: This Crypto meme video is about Terra Luna, a stablecoin like Tether UST that has decreased in value over 99% this week.

asr.full_text: I'm so tired of constantly losing money on risky altcoins. I want more safety in my life. You mean you wanna focus on Bitcoin or something? Probably. It would be nice if there was an even safer option in crypto. There is. Don't you know about stablecoins? What? Stablecoins? Yeah, stablecoins. These are cryptocurrencies which values are tied to another currency such as the us-dollar. There is no volatility in these coins so you don't have to stress about losing money But can I make money on stablecoins? Not on all stablecoins. But I do know a very good one on which you can earn staking rewards! Terra Luna! Terra Luna? Tera Luna Teraluna? Yeah Tera Luna is a stablecoin which gives you staking rewards . You can earn a passive income from it. That sounds amazing . I'm gonna put my life savings in there since it's safe and based on the US dollar. Free passive income for me. What the fu– what the f- Time to stop gambling crypto like a maniac and be a responsible investor! I may not make huge profits with this strategy But, at least, my money is safe and I earn a nice passive income from staking. There you go. It feels good knowing that I can't lose money this time. Bonjour Mister Gwoon Lord Bogdanoff, how can I help you? Dump Terraluna But Terraluna is aid stabolcoin, my Lord Excuse me? Terraluna is aid stabcoin, it can't be dumped Why not? It will destroy the whole cryptomarchy So it is actually possible? Well technically it is possible Don't dump it right now As an order Mr. Guion It will be done My Lord I would like to apologize for my behavior. It feels so good to have my money invested into something that doesn't get shattered to the ground. For years I have been losing money while all this time I could just put it into Terraluna and get staking rewards Terraluner is my hero. Hey! Hey! Oh! Oh! Oh! Oh!

annotation.contextual_rationale: The acted dialogue presents Terra Luna as a safe stablecoin offering staking rewards and links those claims to putting life savings into it, creating a concrete money-and-return relationship. The later acknowledgment that dumping is technically possible, together with the reported loss of more than 99 percent and the meme framing, indicates that the video undercuts the earlier promotion-like claims rather than establishing them as reliable advice. The supplied records do not establish creator endorsement, an actual investment, available rewards, or a completed loss, while the trading interface only shows a depicted portfolio and transaction controls.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary mechanism is participation in a staking-related crypto asset linked to passive returns: the dialogue states that Terra Luna offers staking rewards and passive income, and separately depicts putting life savings into it.
